text:
Transitioned from healthcare consulting to data science, driven by a desire to leverage analytics for better health outcomes. Over the past year, I’ve focused on translating complex data into actionable insights that support clinical decision-making and operational efficiency at HealthInsight Analytics.  

Currently, I’m building predictive models to enhance patient care workflows and optimize resource allocation. My work bridges statistical rigor with real-world impact, ensuring solutions align with both technical and business goals.  

Key tools include NumPy and Pandas for streamlining data pipelines, SQL for extracting meaningful patterns from large datasets, and scikit-learn for developing models that reduce diagnostic errors. I rely on Matplotlib and Plotly to communicate findings visually, while Jupyter notebooks enable iterative analysis. Tableau helps distill insights into intuitive dashboards for cross-functional teams. Feature engineering remains a critical step in refining model performance, often requiring creative approaches to balance complexity and accuracy.  

Open to collaboration and learning. Let’s connect if you’re working on innovative healthtech solutions.
